📢CALLING ALL @TFT PLAYERS!📢

Presenting the next @OhgawdEvents Charity Tournament: THE PRISMATIC PORO CUP!💠⚪️🏆

With the ongoing crisis and severe flooding in the Philippines, many families continue to struggle. Especially as corruption and government inaction have left vital communities without proper relief. That’s why we’re raising funds for The @ABSCBNFI_ph, which provides direct aid, food, and recovery support to those most affected 🇵🇭

071025 @lay_studio Weibo 

“Another year, another special day — happiest birthday to our bravest and most adventurous Boss, @layzhang 💜

In the past year, you’ve continued to be the fearless Captain Lay Zhang Yixing, charting new routes in your ever-growing Grandline Logbook, now on its fifth volume. You’ve also remained the ever curious actor Lay Zhang, exploring uncharted emotional depths. Through Xiao Ma’s quiet gaze, you shared the moving story of The Love You Can’t Speak, touching hearts within and beyond the screen. In The Call of Dunhuang, you transcended time, becoming both Zhang Ran and Master Chang Shuhong, teaching us the profound meaning of devotion and preservation. And, as a relentless music producer, you’ve kept the M-POP dream alive; your latest album Rock the Heavenly Palace, transformed Chinese cultural essence into melodies that travel far and wide.

Just two hours ago, your first Bird’s Nest concert came to an end. You said that though you had stood there countless times before, this was the first time the stage truly belonged to you — almost dreamlike, too unreal to grasp. But to us, it’s the stage you’ve always deserved — not merely a milestone, but a long-awaited medal of honor.

Your creativity and imagination never run dry. You face each challenge with a child’s wonder and a leader’s strength; steadfast even through storms, always steering forward with purpose.

During rehearsals, you said life has many buttons that take time to unfasten. You asked what the Bird’s Nest meant to you — a comma, or a period? We believe it’s a colon — a symbol that leads to the next great chapter, a transition into new adventures ahead: in M-POP, in artistic frontiers, in the limitless exploration of self.

A new year begins — a new age, a new voyage. May you keep your fire alive, and may the winds always be in your favor.
Happy Birthday, Boss @layzhang. The future is boundless — and we’ll continue the journey with you! 🚢💜

#LAYRockingTheBirdsNest 
#Grandline5inBeijing
#1007HappyLAYday
#LAY #ZhangYixing
